comment: One row for each rule of the whole stores of D17.11, which only report until the migration of
those stores ends: the stores that need a proof and the exception of an aggregate `_0`, the
facts of the owners below each destination and the point of their test, the scope of a named
local, the address of a whole store and its stale bit, the cause of each store that the pass
does not prove, the limit of the whole-store work, and that no such store is an error
(src/fort/owner/prover.ft, src/fort/owner/place.ft). Then the lines of the report
(src/fort/owner/report.ft) and the option --whole-store-report (src/fort/driver.ft). The first
stage runs the cases over FIR text and over lowered fort source, the work limit and the lines
of the report (test/fort/owner/prover_whole_test.ft). The second runs the place test, which
holds the marks and the stale bits of the addresses of the whole stores. The third runs the
oracle test of the whole stores, which panics on a store that the pass proves and whose run
stores over a live owner (test/fort/owner/whole_oracle_test.ft). The fourth runs the driver
test, which holds the option and the status of a program with an unproved whole store. The
table runs in the Linux VM with the debug preset and the default runner. The md5 guard reads
the product compiler, whose driver imports owner.prover and owner.report.
The four rows D17.11-whole-event hold the exit location that fir.shadow gives an
`overwrite` (src/fort/fir/shadow.ft, src/fort/fir/interpreter.ft), which the oracle test reads.
The rows D17.11-whole-fresh and D17.11-whole-address-readers and -limit hold the freshness
around the address of a whole store: its `addr` ends no freshness, and its store ends the
freshness of the local of its place before its kill rules, in the walks and in the fresh
dataflow (place.apply_fresh_reads, place.apply_fresh_end); the marks run past the
whole-store work too, and only within it does the stale dataflow keep their bits.
The rows D17.11-gen-member and D17.11-zero hold gen rule 7 of D17.11, the members of a
literal, and the zero value at any depth (place.mark_values, place.is_zero_member): the
rule itself, the operand that it tests, the walk into a nested literal and the temporary
that it enters, the constant key of an element, the chain of zero temporaries, the one
store and the memory of a temporary, and the mark that ends a chain that reads itself.

stages.name: the whole-store module test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 owner/prover_whole_test

stages.name: the place test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 owner/place_test

stages.name: the whole-store oracle test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 owner/whole_oracle_test

stages.name: the driver test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 1500 -j 2 driver_test

mutations.what: no assignment of an owning aggregate is a whole store

mutations.old: bool result = fir.place_fixed(f, s->place) && is_aggregate_result(f, s->place.local);
mutations.what: a store into fixed storage of an aggregate `_0` needs a proof

mutations.old: bool result = fir.place_fixed(f, s->place) && is_aggregate_result(f, s->place.local);
mutations.new: bool result = s->place.base == fir.base_kind.bk_local && is_aggregate_result(f, s->place.local);
mutations.what: a store through a pointer below an aggregate `_0` needs no proof
the pass proves each whole store with a tracked destination
the test reads the fact of the first owner for each owner
the test of a whole store comes before the kill of the call of its right side
a tested whole store applies no kill rule of its own to the walk of its block
a call that kills the fact gives cause 4 and not cause 3
the scope of a named local proves no declaration

mutations.old:
bool named = fir.place_fixed(f, p)
            && fir.local_at(f, p.local)->kind == fir.local_kind.lk_named;
mutations.new:
bool named = p.base == fir.base_kind.bk_local
            && fir.local_at(f, p.local)->kind == fir.local_kind.lk_named;
mutations.what: the scope bit of a named local proves a store through it
the scope test reads the bit after the store and not before it

mutations.old:
apply_ended(c, fir.block_statement(f, b, i), at);
            i += 1;
mutations.what: the scope test reads the bit at the entry of the block of the store
the test reads the address of a whole store as a place through it
a stale address of a whole store reads as the place of its `addr`
an address that another item reads is an address of a whole store
the store of an address of a whole store keeps it stale
the pass marks no address of a whole store
a destination that is no tracked place takes facts
an index with no key gives cause 2 and not cause 1
the whole-store work has no limit
the whole-store work counts no step of an owner

mutations.new:
return p->unproved > 0 || p->leaks > 0 || p->aggregate_leaks > 0 || p->use_unproved > 0
        || p->whole_leaks > 0;
mutations.what: a whole store that the pass does not prove is a compile error
the report gives a store of one position at each expansion and at each arm
the report names no store by the target of its assignment
the report writes the target of a deref with no parenthesis
--whole-store-report lists no store
an overwrite keeps no exit location

mutations.old: bool same_exit = o->exit.line == exit.line && o->exit.col == exit.col;
mutations.what: the events of two expansions of one deferred store at one location give one event
a step of the run sets no exit location
the store of a call result keeps the exit location of the callee
the `addr` of the address of a whole store ends the freshness of its local
a store through the address of a whole store keeps the freshness of the local of its place
a store through the address of a whole store ends the freshness of each local
the walks keep the freshness at a store through the address of a whole store
the fresh dataflow carries no end of freshness of a store through the address of a whole store
the stale dataflow keeps no bit of an address of a whole store
past the whole-store work, the `addr` of the address of a whole store ends freshness
a store of a literal makes no member empty
a member that holds a value is empty
a member of a nested literal is never empty
the walk of the members enters a temporary whose value is not known
each element names the first member of an array literal
a temporary that moves a zero temporary holds no zero value

mutations.old: return fir.local_at(c->f, t)->kind == fir.local_kind.lk_temp && is_single(c, t)
mutations.what: a temporary that two stores write holds the value of its last store

mutations.old: return fir.local_at(c->f, t)->kind == fir.local_kind.lk_temp && is_single(c, t)
mutations.new:
return fir.local_at(c->f, t)->kind == fir.local_kind.lk_temp
        && c->locals[cast(t, u64)].assigns == 1
mutations.what: a temporary that is memory holds the value of its store
the walk of the values has no mark while it reads a store, so a chain that reads itself does not end
